Smoke test: load sflog and parse a simple snippet

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"sflog\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("37.0 APEX_CODE,DEBUG\n16:06:58.18 (1)|EXECUTION_STARTED\n", config)
    println(result)
}
```
